environment.description: Same Node.js 18 IoT gateway on ECS Fargate. Fronted by CloudFront distribution with origin request timeout set to 3000ms. Origin is ALB with idle timeout 4s. The ALB target group has a deregistration delay of 300s and health check interval of 5s on /health. CloudFront distribution has a custom origin response timeout of 3s. Additionally, the ECS task definition specifies a ulimit for cpu time (RLIMIT_CPU) of 2 seconds soft / 5 seconds hard via the task definition's ulimits parameter. The container also runs with a read-only root filesystem and has a custom seccomp profile that restricts clock_nanosleep and nanosleep syscalls to prevent artificial delays. Response headers policy on CloudFront includes Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none' which is applied via a managed response headers policy attached to the distribution behavior.
